---
title: 8 - Title
---

```html
<body>

    <!-- Map container -->
    <div id="map" class="map">

      <!-- Map title -->
      <h1 class="map-title">
        Tanzania forest reserves and conservation areas
      </h1>
```

```css
/* ----------------------------------------
    Map title (bottom-left)
---------------------------------------- */
.map-title {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 10px;
  left: 10px;
  z-index: 1000; /* Z-index keeps UI elements above the map */
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
}
```
